استحفظن (form X)
# اِسْتَحْفَظْنَ (istaḥfaẓna) /is.taħ.faðˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَحْفَظَ (istaḥfaẓa)
# اُسْتُحْفِظْنَ (ustuḥfiẓna) /us.tuħ.fiðˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَحْفَظَ (istaḥfaẓa)
# اِسْتَحْفِظْنَ (istaḥfiẓna) /is.taħ.fiðˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَحْفَظَ (istaḥfaẓa)
